# Reference fields correctly detected but not implementable right now.
#
# Almost always: the target has no KCC resource and no Ref type yet, and
# creating <kind>_reference.go / <kind>_identity.go is a separate step. Without
# this list a correct finding with no legal resolution blocks all work on the
# resource.
#
# This is NOT missingrefs.txt relief by another name. Adding an entry is a
# deliberate, reviewable edit with a stated reason - not the silent absorption a
# golden file allows. Every entry needs a reason=.
#
# Format:
#   [refs] crd=<crd> version=v1alpha1: field ".spec.foo" reason=<why>
#
# SANDBOX-ONLY. Not upstream policy.
[refs] crd=vertexaibatchpredictionjobs.vertexai.cnrm.cloud.google.com version=v1alpha1: field ".spec.model" reason=no-vertexaimodel-ref-type-exists-creating-one-is-a-separate-step
